about.title: Many organisations, shared causes, rarely together
about.text: Information is scattered across dozens of websites and languages. Partners from other countries are found mostly through personal contacts. Small and local organisations stay outside European networks. 4ngo brings all of this together in one place.

sections.p: 4ngo.eu is run by the Association “Education for Democracy” (Prosveta za Demokratsia), UIC 208660971, 29 General Skobelev Str., 5870 Dolni Dabnik, Bulgaria. For questions about personal data, write to hello@4ngo.eu.
The website has no forms, registration or user accounts and does not collect personal data. Fonts and images are served from our own server, without third-party services.
The website does not use cookies and does not track visitors. That is why there is no consent banner.
Like any website, the server may record technical data such as IP address, date and time of a visit. This is used only for the security and operation of the website.
Links to Facebook, Instagram, Threads and LinkedIn lead to websites with their own privacy policies.
Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) you have the right to access, rectify and erase data, and the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection authority.
